manifest.name: data-quality-issue
manifest.description: One explainable data-quality finding about a record Accordo owns, with the evidence that produced it. Governing an issue records a human decision and never erases the finding: a resolved issue keeps its history, and none of this is a compliance or legal-assurance claim.

migrations.name: create_data_quality_issues
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_quality_issues (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  kind TEXT CHECK(kind IN ('missing_required_identity', 'conflicting_external_identity', 'identity_conflict_windowed_scope', 'invalid_email', 'invalid_domain', 'duplicate_candidate_open', 'orphaned_reference', 'unresolved_import_row')),
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  subject_label TEXT,
  evidence TEXT,
  detector TEXT,
  detector_version INTEGER,
  detected_by_run_id TEXT,
  detected_at TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('open', 'resolved', 'dismissed')),
  resolution_reason TEXT,
  decided_by_type TEXT CHECK(decided_by_type IN ('user')),
  decided_by_id TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_quality_issues_kind ON data_quality_issues(kind);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_quality_issues_subject_resource ON data_quality_issues(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_quality_issues_subject_id ON data_quality_issues(subject_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_quality_issues_status ON data_quality_issues(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_data_quality_issues
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."data_quality_issues" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "kind" TEXT CHECK("kind" IN ('missing_required_identity', 'conflicting_external_identity', 'identity_conflict_windowed_scope', 'invalid_email', 'invalid_domain', 'duplicate_candidate_open', 'orphaned_reference', 'unresolved_import_row')),
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "evidence" TEXT,
  "detector" TEXT,
  "detector_version" BIGINT,
  "detected_by_run_id" TEXT,
  "detected_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('open', 'resolved', 'dismissed')),
  "resolution_reason" TEXT,
  "decided_by_type" TEXT CHECK("decided_by_type" IN ('user')),
  "decided_by_id" TEXT,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "data_quality_issues_kind"
  ON "accordo"."data_quality_issues"("kind");

CREATE INDEX "data_quality_issues_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."data_quality_issues"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "data_quality_issues_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."data_quality_issues"("subject_id");

CREATE INDEX "data_quality_issues_status"
  ON "accordo"."data_quality_issues"("status");
